subject: AcmeHealth SOC 2 Type II — initial intake & quick-share playbook
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II report + bridge options

Hi Stephanie / Laura,

We are in the final stages of our vendor review for the AcmeHealth integration. Can you please share Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering operational controls) and advise on the audit period covered? In particular we need:

- Confirmation of the report period (start/end dates).
- A copy of the bridge letter or statement of conditions if the report period doesn't cover our in-scope dates.
- A minimal set of artifacts we can expect (control descriptions, log samples, retention policy excerpts).
- Preferred transfer mechanism (SFTP / presigned S3 / secure Drive link) and expected turnaround time.

Attached is a short evidence manifest template we use for vendor intake (acme_evidence_manifest.xlsx) — feel free to return it populated if helpful.

We are hoping to have the assurance package in hand by 2025-11-12 to stay on our procurement timeline. If there are any blockers please let us know.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Security Engineering Manager
AcmeHealth

Attachment: acme_evidence_manifest.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II report + bridge options

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear ask and the manifest. Short answer: we can share the Type II report and offer a bridge letter if needed. Next steps and options below.

1) Report & audit period
- Our latest SOC 2 Type II (security, availability) covers 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31. We can provide the full report PDF under NDA.

2) Bridge letter options
- If your in-scope window extends past 2024-12-31, we can provide a bridge letter describing changes since the last report and confirm no material control regressions. Two formats: (a) short-form bridge (1 page) for procurement, or (b) extended bridge with sample control evidence (2–3 pages). Ive attached our bridge template (redwood_bridge_letter_template_v1.docx).

3) What to share / minimal artifacts
- Control matrix PDF (control IDs + owner + description)
- Sample logs (redaction-friendly snippets) — e.g., IAM audit trail, infra change log, and access review summary
- Retention policy excerpt (logs & backups)
- Contact for auditor follow-up (we can list an ops contact or provide narrowly scoped presigned links)

4) Transfer options and timeline
- Preferred: presigned S3 links (expires 7 days). We will upload a secure bundle and share links + checksum.
- Alternative: SFTP (customer-provisioned) or secure Drive link.
- Typical turnaround: report + bridge draft within 2 business days after we agree on NDA and transfer method; artifacts (samples) within 3 business days.

5) Quick reply templates (one-line options you can paste):
- "Thanks — presigned S3 works; please send links and access dates."
- "We need the extended bridge with sample logs — please proceed."
- "Confirming NDA; please share the report and artifact bundle."

Action items: Laura, Rafael — can you prepare the report bundle and generate presigned links if S3 is fine? I will send a concise bridge letter draft to Jane for review.

Best,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_template_v1.docx, presigned_s3_instructions.txt

Jane — two one-liners that may speed this up:

I'll upload the bundle and post links by Thu 2025-11-06 EOD Pacific unless you prefer SFTP. Rafael, please prepare the CSV and pick the 3 log snippets (IAM, infra changes, access review).
